items.name: Burrata
items.description: Creamy burrata with tomatoes, basil, and toasted bread.
items.longDescription: Hand-stretched burrata over sun-ripened heirloom tomatoes with cold-pressed basil oil and Maldon salt. Thick slices of charred sourdough on the side.

items.name: Tuna Tartare
items.description: Fresh tuna, avocado, soy-ginger, crispy wonton.
items.longDescription: Yellowfin diced à la minute, dressed in tamari, ginger, and yuzu. Folded with Hass avocado, topped with paper-thin radish and toasted sesame.

items.name: Brussels Sprouts
items.description: Roasted crispy with honey-chili glaze and almonds.
items.longDescription: Halved sprouts flash-fried until lacy and dark, tossed in a sweet-spicy honey glaze. Finished with toasted almonds and pickled shallot.

items.name: Buffalo Wings
items.description: Crispy wings, buffalo sauce, blue cheese, celery.
items.longDescription: Bone-in wings brined overnight, twice-fried for shatter-crisp skin, tossed in our house buffalo. Cold celery and blue cheese on the side.

items.name: Tomato Soup
items.description: Creamy roasted tomato soup with basil and crouton.
items.longDescription: San Marzano tomatoes roasted with garlic and shallot, blended velvety smooth, finished with basil oil and a quenelle of crème fraîche. Big focaccia crouton on top.

items.name: Margherita Pizza
items.description: Wood-fired thin crust, tomato, mozzarella, basil.
items.longDescription: House dough cold-fermented 48 hours, stretched thin and blistered in our wood oven. Topped with crushed San Marzano, fior di latte, basil, and olive oil.

items.name: Spicy Chicken Sandwich
items.description: Fried chicken with Nashville hot sauce on a brioche bun.
items.longDescription: Boneless thigh brined in buttermilk 24 hours, pressure-fried, then brushed with Nashville hot oil. Layered with pickles and slaw on a toasted brioche bun.

items.name: Fried Chicken Sandwich
items.description: Crispy fried chicken with garlic aioli on brioche.
items.longDescription: Same 24-hour buttermilk brine and shatter-crispy crust as our spicy version, dressed with garlic aioli, butter lettuce, and a thick slice of tomato on a brioche bun.

items.name: Cheeseburger
items.description: Smash burger, aged cheddar, bacon jam, potato bun.
items.longDescription: Dry-aged beef smashed on a hot flat-top for a crispy crust. Topped with aged cheddar, sweet-savory bacon jam, butter lettuce, and house pickles on a potato bun.

items.name: Mushroom Grilled Cheese
items.description: Roasted mushrooms, gruyère, caramelized onion, sourdough.
items.longDescription: Wild mushrooms roasted with thyme and sherry, layered with melted gruyère and caramelized onion between buttered sourdough and griddled golden.

items.name: Lobster Roll
items.description: Cold-water lobster, lemon-tarragon mayo, buttered bun.
items.longDescription: A quarter-pound of Maine lobster knuckle and claw, lightly dressed in lemon-tarragon mayo. Tucked into a buttered, griddled split-top bun with chips on the side.

items.name: Grilled Salmon
items.description: Salmon with lemon-caper butter, couscous, broccolini.
items.longDescription: North Atlantic salmon seared skin-on for shatter-crispy skin, finished with lemon-caper brown butter over pearl couscous and herbs. Charred broccolini on the side.

items.name: Ribeye Steak
items.description: 12oz prime ribeye, peppercorn jus, hand-cut fries.
items.longDescription: Twelve ounces of USDA Prime ribeye, dry-aged 28 days for deep flavor. Seared on the plancha, finished with smoked salt and a peppercorn pan jus. Hand-cut fries on the side.

items.name: Mushroom Risotto
items.description: Creamy arborio rice with porcini, parmesan, truffle oil.
items.longDescription: Carnaroli rice stirred with white wine and mushroom stock until creamy. Folded with porcini, sautéed trumpets, and aged parmesan. White truffle oil and chives to finish.

items.name: Pesto Pasta
items.description: Fresh linguine with basil pesto, cherry tomatoes, pecorino.
items.longDescription: Fresh linguine tossed with vibrant green pesto from Genovese basil, pine nuts, garlic, and aged pecorino. Finished with sweet blistered cherry tomatoes.

items.name: Roast Chicken
items.description: Half chicken with lemon, rosemary, potatoes, jus.
items.longDescription: Half a free-range chicken brined and roasted with lemon, rosemary, and thyme until the skin is mahogany-crisp. Served with smashed fingerling potatoes and pan jus.

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.description: Romaine, parmesan, croutons, anchovy dressing.
items.longDescription: Crisp little gem lettuce dressed in our white-anchovy Caesar with lemon and cured egg yolk. Topped with curls of parmesan and focaccia croutons fried in garlic butter.

items.name: Quinoa Bowl
items.description: Kale, quinoa, roasted squash, pomegranate, lemon dressing.
items.longDescription: Massaged lacinato kale, fluffy red quinoa, and roasted delicata squash with pomegranate seeds and toasted pepitas. Preserved-lemon vinaigrette.

items.name: Cobb Salad
items.description: Romaine, avocado, bacon, blue cheese, egg, tomato.
items.longDescription: Crisp romaine arranged with rows of jammy egg, smoked bacon, cherry tomato, ripe avocado, and crumbled blue cheese. Red-wine vinaigrette.

items.name: Truffle Fries
items.description: Hand-cut fries with truffle oil and parmesan.
items.longDescription: Russet potatoes hand-cut and double-fried for shatter-crisp outsides and pillowy centers. Tossed hot with truffle oil, parmesan, and parsley.

items.name: Mac & Cheese
items.description: Cavatappi with three cheeses, baked golden.
items.longDescription: Cavatappi blanketed in a velvety béchamel of aged cheddar, gruyère, and parmesan. Baked in a cast iron with a buttery herbed-breadcrumb topping.

items.name: Garlic Bread
items.description: Sourdough with roasted garlic butter and parsley.
items.longDescription: Thick slices of house sourdough smothered in roasted-garlic compound butter, finished with parsley and flaky sea salt. Toasted hard, served hot.

items.name: Side Salad
items.description: Mixed greens, fennel, white balsamic.
items.longDescription: A simple, bright counterpoint: tender mixed greens, shaved fennel, and a quick toss in lemon-white-balsamic with cracked pepper.

items.name: Iced Tea
items.description: Cold-brewed black tea with lemon.
items.longDescription: Single-origin Ceylon black tea cold-brewed 12 hours for a smooth, never-bitter cup. Over ice with a wedge of lemon.

items.name: Lemonade
items.description: Fresh-squeezed lemons with mint.
items.longDescription: Meyer lemons squeezed to order, balanced with raw cane sugar simple syrup and a generous bunch of crushed mint. Served tall over ice.

items.name: Cappuccino
items.description: Espresso with steamed milk and cocoa.
items.longDescription: A double shot of our house espresso blend topped with silky steamed milk and a dusting of dark cocoa. Served in a warmed ceramic cup.

items.name: Cold Brew
items.description: Slow-steeped coffee, served over ice.
items.longDescription: Coarse-ground Ethiopian beans steeped in cold filtered water for 18 hours, then filtered twice for clarity. Served black over ice.

items.name: Red Wine
items.description: Cabernet Sauvignon by the glass.
items.longDescription: A medium-plus bodied Sonoma Cabernet — black cherry, cedar, and soft tannins. Pairs beautifully with our ribeye or burger.

items.name: Draft Beer
items.description: Rotating local IPA on tap.
items.longDescription: Always rotating, always local. Currently pouring a West Coast IPA: bright citrus and pine, dry finish.

items.name: Chocolate Cake
items.description: Flourless dark chocolate cake with sea salt.
items.longDescription: An impossibly rich flourless torte made with Valrhona 70% dark chocolate and brown butter. Served with crème fraîche and a pinch of Maldon salt.

items.name: Crème Brûlée
items.description: Vanilla custard with caramelized sugar crust.
items.longDescription: Slow-baked custard scented with vanilla bean, topped with a hand-torched layer of caramelized sugar that cracks under your spoon. Macerated berries.

items.name: Tiramisu
items.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers with mascarpone and cocoa.
items.longDescription: Layers of espresso-soaked savoiardi between clouds of mascarpone whipped with Marsala wine and egg yolk. Dusted with bitter cocoa.

items.name: Apple Pie
items.description: Warm apple crumble with vanilla ice cream.
items.longDescription: Honeycrisp and Pink Lady apples tossed in cinnamon and Calvados, baked under an oat-pecan crumble. Served warm with a scoop of vanilla bean ice cream.
